title: Bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Left wing of bow tie -->
  <path d='M48,50 L18,30 L18,70 Z' fill='#e63946' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Right wing of bow tie -->
  <path d='M52,50 L82,30 L82,70 Z' fill='#e63946' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Left wing highlight -->
  <path d='M44,50 L24,34 L24,66 Z' fill='#ff6b81' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Right wing highlight -->
  <path d='M56,50 L76,34 L76,66 Z' fill='#ff6b81' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Center knot -->
  <rect x='43' y='40' width='14' height='20' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#c1121f' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Knot highlight -->
  <rect x='46' y='43' width='4' height='14' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Polka dots on left wing -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Polka dots on right wing -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
